PORT.description: Port the Node/Express server listens on.

NODE_ENV.description: Express cookie secure flag is enabled when set to 'production'.

UPLOAD_DIR.description: Filesystem path for uploaded files. Backed by the /uploads Railway volume.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL used for invite/verification links. Auto-derived from the Railway public domain.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Express-session signing key. Auto-generated on deploy; rotating invalidates all active sessions.

MONGODB_URI.description: Mongo connection string. Auto-wired to the mongo companion service via companion-mapping.json.

ALLOW_REGISTRATION.description: Set to 'false' to disable public signups (admin must invite users).

MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: Per-file upload size cap in megabytes. Single-fs upload, not chunked.
